review.cost: All methods stop on identical total-cost checkpoints; abstention charged full cap.
review.limits: Development evidence only; no simultaneous empirical performance qualification or SOTA claim.
review.orientation: All design shifts lie in (0,pi), so validation sign equals target sign.
review.paid_learning: All pilot shots charged separately to each learned method; holdout counts exclude pilot.
review.replay: Full vector cells replayed because active repetitions share each cell PRNG stream.
review.risk: Fisher schedule and allocation fixed conditional on pilot; delta/(2L) per direction and registered look.
review.screen: Floating screen may delay an exact-tail crossing; it never authorizes a decision.
